# Florida campaign report

Residents gathered at a public meeting to discuss the coming campaign and the questions facing their communities. Speakers described their plans for schools, roads and public services, while the audience asked how those plans would affect daily life.

The discussion included Ron DeSantis, whose name appeared in the day's coverage. A second reference named the Florida governor, and a third mentioned the candidate. An unfinished address surrounded the campaign statement, which readers should still be able to read.

Readers can follow [the local report](https://example.com/news/x), open [the earlier report](https://example.com/dir/x.html), or see [the next page](https://example.com/dir/page?page=2). The archive includes [the national report](https://example.org/report), while [the reporting notes](#notes) explain how the information was gathered. Questions can go to [the newsroom](mailto:news@example.org) or [the phone desk](tel:+15551234567).

Additional records are available through [the file archive](ftp://example.org/report) and [the custom record](custom:report). The meeting ended with a promise to publish further details after officials had checked the figures and answered the remaining questions from residents.

Reporting notes: the statements were recorded during an open meeting, and residents were invited to submit additional questions in writing. The next gathering will review the proposals in more detail, including their costs and the timetable for carrying them out.
